note: Single source of truth for the pinned Spektrum version. index.html's import map, public/vendor/spektrum.min.js, and src/types/spektrum.d.ts must all move together when this changes. Bump via scripts/sync-vendor-spektrum.mjs (Feature 01.5), never by hand-editing the hash. sha384 covers vendoredPath (the pinned upstream bytes); runtimePath is generated from it by scripts/spektrum-csp.mjs and is what index.html actually loads.
